name: ZBP Enterprise Baseline
description: Zscaler Best Practice (ZBP) enterprise DLP baseline: US PII, US PHI, financial information, ITAR, Traffic Light Protocol markings and private keys, as monitor-only web DLP rules with their dictionaries and engines. Immutable: objects that drift from this definition are restored on the next deploy. Upstream ships the rules DISABLED; this baseline enables them (ALLOW = monitor only, no user impact).
source: mkoyfman/zbp-automation zbp-enterprise-zia (Zscaler Best Practice enterprise pack)
